client: I've been struggling a lot since I lost my dog last month. It feels like a part of me is missing, and I can't find joy in anything I used to love. Some days, I wonder if this feeling will ever go away or if therapy can really help me through this.
therapist: It sounds like you’re experiencing a deep sense of loss and emptiness since your dog's passing, which can be incredibly painful. Your feelings of grief and uncertainty about the future are valid, and it's understandable to question whether things will improve. Remember, healing takes time, and therapy can offer support as you navigate this difficult journey. I'm here to help you find ways to cope and eventually rediscover joy.
